source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok. Apologies for the late reply. Yes, on the LED lights. Please pick some suitable ones that will work with your setup. I'm not sure what you mean by, " I could add button to the list similar to that one instead of the on off switch that it is now." What I am trying to avoid is another base being built without us being on the same page creatively. The base will be the most visible part. If we can add some extra details to give the machine some flash and pizazz, that's the idea. I just want it to be fun to look at for social media.
